run_IFInpaintingPipeline: run the IFInpaintingPipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image using a text prompt
encode_prompt_IFInpaintingPipeline: encode a text prompt into T5 text embeddings for the IF inpainting pipeline
preprocess_image_IFInpaintingPipeline: preprocess a PIL image or tensor for use as input to the IF inpainting pipeline
preprocess_mask_image_IFInpaintingPipeli: preprocess a mask image to a binary tensor for the IF inpainting pipeline
resize_PIL_image: resize a PIL image to a target size while preserving aspect ratio and aligning to multiples of 8
